assets.description: 远处空中几只飞虫，棉花叶面干净。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 Clean, recognizably broad green cotton leaf in the foreground. Three tiny winged black insects are in pale blue air well ABOVE the clean leaf, visibly separated by a large gap, never on the leaf.

从叶背斜看一组小蚜虫趴在棉花叶上。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 Close side angle of a large green cotton leaf, three to four distinct small pale yellow-green oval aphids with tiny legs actually touching and resting ON the leaf surface. No flying insects or field.
稻苗和水面附近有小虫，画面没有棉花叶。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 Small dark insect close to the waterline in shallow blue paddy, three green rice seedlings with bases submerged. No broad cotton leaf and no other character.

转头停在竖树干边的啄木鸟新姿态。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 Clear red-crowned black and cream woodpecker turned to look back, clinging to a visibly vertical tree trunk. Strong straight pointed beak. New composition, different from front-on lesson drawing. No other animal.

燕子飞过画面，叉尾清楚。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 One recognizable fork-tailed swallow in clean air, angled differently from the lesson bird, gently banking with a recognizable dark navy wing silhouette and deep split tail. No trunk, no other animal.
绿色青蛙站在水田的小泥坡。本组视角和大小一致。与课堂画的构图不同。 One green frog on a small muddy rice-paddy bank. Clear hind legs and frog face, water and a few stems of grass. No bird.

薄荷底单张卷起来一角的米白纸牌，上面一片细绿叶轮廓，无字无号码，居中清楚 One large pale parchment card with a subtle rolled corner, a simple large moss-green cotton leaf silhouette in the middle, backed by a pale mint square within this cell. No lettering or marks other than the single leaf.
